rule: seed(TAG, j) = 2^62 + (first 8 bytes, big-endian, of SHA-256(R || TAG || j as 2 bytes big-endian)) mod 2^62; R = the 32 randomness bytes of retest/beacon.json (bb72/ising_compare/bb/shots.py test_seed, stage 3's formula); native chunk k of a set takes the k-th beacon index it is assigned (j0 + k unless an index was dropped); collision rule: the sets of one TAG take their chunks in order of j0, each chunk the smallest index >= j0 that no earlier chunk took, an index whose seed equals an earlier chunk's seed or a historical seed (historical_seeds.txt) is dropped and the next index tried (retest/seeds.py assign)
